description: A Bible story by its name: what happens, where it is told, and the text itself, e.g. "The Prodigal Son", "David and Goliath", "Jonah". Names in English and Norwegian both work. Other stories the name could mean are listed with their ids.

edition.description: Edition to quote the verses from: osnb (Norwegian Bokmål), osnn (Norwegian Nynorsk), osen (English), sblgnt (Greek New Testament) or tanach (Hebrew Old Testament). Default: the edition for `language`.

include_text.description: true quotes the passages the story is told in (at most 80 verses in all); false gives the passages only. Default: true.

language.description: Language for names, notes and study content, and for the links to bible.flogvit.com: en (English), nb (Norwegian Bokmål), nn (Norwegian Nynorsk), sv (Swedish), fr (French), es (Spanish), fi (Finnish), de (German). Content missing in a language falls back to English. Default: en.

mapping.description: Verse numbering to give the verse references in: a mapping id from list_verse_mappings, e.g. "english_kj" (King James) or "dnb2024_nb", or a short name such as "kjv". Default: osnb, the site's own numbering.

name.description: The story's title or id, or words from it, e.g. "The Prodigal Son", "den-fortapte-sonn", "Goliath", "Den barmhjertige samaritan".

name: get_story
title: A Bible story
